verdict.rationale: Rollbar's homepage says it "points you to the code behind each error" (rollbar-docs-49). A community comment references GitHub credentials "for source code integration" (rollbar-comm-2), and Resolve opens pull requests (rollbar-docs-48), which implies a repo connection. That is only glancing support for this story: Item Owner is a manually designated Rollbar user, not repo-derived code owners. Missing for 10: documented suspect-commit attribution, CODEOWNERS-based ownership, explicit stack-frame-to-line links on the default branch, repo integration setup docs, and hands-on corroboration.
